rationale: Imported theme-painted range/checkbox/radio controls (native_theme verdict native) lower onto the existing Chromium-refresh widget skins from capture-recorded HTML state (ua_* attributes, color-scheme newly captured, inputChecked read), with their UA-default background/border dropped; the skins paint in the captured CSS-px-snapped rect via View::self_paint_bounds(). Only native-verdict imported controls are affected; Chromium stays the only oracle and Skia/Dawn the renderer, so no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
